response.sql:
WITH invoice_prices AS (
    SELECT
        i.InvoiceId,
        i.CustomerId,
        AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.CustomerId
),
invoice_deviations AS (
    SELECT
        ip.InvoiceId,
        c.Country,
        ip.average_unit_price,
        ip.average_unit_price - AVG(ip.average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation_from_overall_average
    FROM invoice_prices AS ip
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = ip.CustomerId
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        Country,
        average_unit_price,
        deviation_from_overall_average,
        deviation_from_overall_average - AVG(deviation_from_overall_average) OVER (PARTITION BY Country)
            AS deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
    FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    Country,
    average_unit_price AS average_unit_price,
    deviation_from_overall_average,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation
FROM scored
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN deviation_minus_country_average_deviation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    deviation_minus_country_average_deviation DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: An invoice's average unit price is the unweighted average of its line UnitPrice values; invoices with no lines are excluded because their average is undefined. The overall average is the unweighted average of those invoice averages, and each country's average deviation is the unweighted average of its invoices' deviations. Invoices whose customer country is NULL form one country group.
